about: The derived metrics a device has, and what a schema may name. One rule in SQL (device_derived_metrics() and schema_derived_metric_problems(), 0336), in the dashboard (derivedMetricsOfDevice() and derivedProblems() in utils/derivedMetric.js) and, for the first, in the AAS exporter (derivedMetricsFor() in _shared/aas/shell.ts). Each is run over these cases and gives exactly these answers.

problems.about: A metric named in `required` alone is modelled
One input of two is not modelled
problems: Fixture_0336_D/NET is computed from Fixture_0336/PHASE_B, which this schema does not model. Add Fixture_0336/PHASE_B to its metrics, or leave Fixture_0336_D/NET out.

problems.about: Every reason, in the order of the names and of the inputs
problems: Fixture_0336_D/PARTS_PER_HOUR is computed from Fixture_0336/PART_COUNT, which this schema does not model. Add Fixture_0336/PART_COUNT to its metrics, or leave Fixture_0336_D/PARTS_PER_HOUR out.
Fixture_0336_D/NET is computed from Fixture_0336/PHASE_A, which this schema does not model. Add Fixture_0336/PHASE_A to its metrics, or leave Fixture_0336_D/NET out.
Fixture_0336_D/NET is computed from Fixture_0336/PHASE_B, which this schema does not model. Add Fixture_0336/PHASE_B to its metrics, or leave Fixture_0336_D/NET out.
Fixture_0336_D/NOWHERE is not in the metric catalogue. Add it on the Metrics page first.
Fixture_0336/PART_COUNT is a measured metric, so it goes among the metrics the schema models. A schema's derived metrics are the ones Aber computes.

problems.about: A deprecated one is not added
problems: Fixture_0336_D/RETIRED is deprecated. A schema may keep it but not add it.

problems.about: A deprecated one is kept where the version names it
A deprecated one that is kept still needs its input
problems: Fixture_0336_D/RETIRED is computed from Fixture_0336/PART_COUNT, which this schema does not model. Add Fixture_0336/PART_COUNT to its metrics, or leave Fixture_0336_D/RETIRED out.

problems.about: The schema's copy of the input permits every state
The schema's copy of the input restricts nothing
The schema's copy of the input leaves one state out
problems: Fixture_0336_D/AUTOMATIC counts the state "SEMI", which this schema does not permit Fixture_0336/MODE to report (SETUP, AUTO). Leave Fixture_0336_D/AUTOMATIC out, or add the state to the metric's permitted values.

problems.about: A boolean's permitted values are true and false, and a state is text
A boolean that may only be false
problems: Fixture_0336_D/DOOR_OPEN counts the state "true", which this schema does not permit Fixture_0336/DOOR to report (false). Leave Fixture_0336_D/DOOR_OPEN out, or add the state to the metric's permitted values.
